description: This file implements an authentication page component for a Next.js application, supporting email/password and magic link sign-in/up using Supabase. It manages user input, authentication actions, and redirects upon successful login.

methods.name: AuthPageInner
methods.description: React component handling the internal authentication logic and UI, including form state, event handlers, and side effects for redirecting authenticated users.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Event handler for form submission that initiates authentication with Supabase depending on the current mode (sign in, sign up, magic link).
